about: Which block of a note an overlay placed {after: quote} goes under. block: the index of the body's text block (paragraphs and headings, those inside lists and quotes too, in order; not the title, and not code or other raw blocks, which show their source), or null for the top of the body. Searched as written in each block's own Markdown, then by the quote's longest line without block syntax, then by that line without inline Markdown in exactly one block's text.
